CROOKED ATTIC BEDROOM: a tiny room tucked under crooked beams, a brass bed heaped with seven mismatched patchwork quilts, a mushroom-shaped lamp glowing on an upturned crate, a wonky shelf crowded with teacups, a round window set into the sloping eave right above the pillow

PATCHWORK ATTIC ROOM: a low-ceilinged attic with beams draped in strings of fairy lights, a fat iron bed piled with quilts in every colour, a lopsided bookshelf leaning gently against the plaster, a round porthole window cut into the gable end above the headboard

STARGAZER'S ATTIC: a snug room under dramatically sloping rafters, a brass bed buried under a mountain of quilts, a small cauldron-sized mug on the bedside stump, hanging dried herbs swaying from the beams, a round window in the roof slope directly overhead

EMBER ATTIC BEDROOM: a warm attic room with softly bowed floorboards, a bed heaped so high with quilts a step-stool leans against it, a mushroom lamp on a patchwork pouffe, little clay pots of happy trailing plants on every beam ledge, a round window in the slanted wall beside the pillow

CAULDRON KITCHEN: a snug kitchen with a fat black stove shaped like a friendly cauldron, shelves of cloth-topped jam jars glowing in candy colours, an entire wall crowded with mismatched teapots, a striped rag rug underfoot, one wide window set above the deep stone sink

HONEYPOT KITCHEN: a round-cornered kitchen with a plump black stove wearing a cheerfully crooked chimney pipe, rows of cloth-topped jam jars in improbable pinks and greens, a cluster of teapots hanging from ceiling hooks, a braided rug in mustard and red, a wide window beside the flour-dusted wooden table

BRAMBLE KITCHEN: a cosy kitchen with beamed ceilings, a fat black stove with little clawed feet, shelves of cloth-topped jam jars in every jewel colour, a wall of mismatched teapots lined up like a choir, a patchwork curtain below the counter, a small square window above the stone basin

SPELLBOOK KITCHEN: a snug kitchen with a friendly black stove squatting on stubby legs, a wall entirely covered in teapots of every shape and size, cloth-topped jam jars glowing amber and violet on the shelf above, a braided rug underfoot, a tall narrow window beside the heavy wooden door

BOOKSHELF READING NOOK: a tiny reading room where the bed is carved directly into a bookshelf, surrounded on three sides by leaning paperbacks and folded maps of imaginary places, a mushroom lamp on a built-in ledge, a round window above the foot of the bed casting a warm circle of light

CUSHION CAVE NOOK: a deep window seat so padded with mismatched cushions it resembles a nest, bookshelves closing around it on both sides, a patchwork curtain to draw across for privacy, a fat candle in a clay holder on the sill, the wide arched window framing the seat from behind

LANTERN READING NOOK: a small alcove room with a built-in bench bed tucked into a bookshelf wall, quilts folded in fat stacks, a mushroom-shaped lamp perched on a stack of books, trailing ivy growing along the top shelf, a round window set into the end wall right at eye level when lying down

TURPENTINE TOWER STUDIO: a tall narrow painter's tower room with curved walls, paint jars in candy colours crowding every ledge, a tilted easel in the centre, bundles of brushes in old cloth-topped jam jars, a patchwork curtain pooled on the floor, a round porthole window high in the curving wall above

CANDY JAR STUDIO: a small artist's room with shelves of paint jars glowing in sherbet pinks and lemon yellows, a wonky wooden easel, rolled canvases stacked in a corner, a rag rug splattered cheerfully with colour, a wide window set low in the wall beside the easel

PIGMENT ATELIER: a cosy studio with plank walls hung with unframed patchwork canvases, a fat jar of brushes on every surface, paint jars in candy colours arranged along a crooked shelf, a small round rug in the middle, a tall arched window in the gable wall flooding the easel with light

WOBBLY TEA ROOM: a snug parlour with a wonky pedestal table at its centre, mismatched chairs gathered around it, a smiling teapot on a lace doily, shelves of patterned cups, a small patchwork hanging on the wall, a wide bay window set into the front wall beside the table

CLOVER TEA ROOM: a round-walled room with a lopsided pedestal table and two cushioned chairs that are charmingly mismatched, a fat smiling teapot as the centrepiece, cloth-topped jam jars of dried flowers on the mantel, a braided rug underfoot, a round window in the curved wall to one side of the table

BURROW SITTING ROOM: a round-doored cabin room with log walls, a little iron stove with a beautifully bent chimney, a braided rug in earthy reds, a lumpy armchair beside the stove, dried herbs hanging in bundles from low beams, a round porthole window set into the thick log wall

ROOT CELLAR CABIN: a snug low-ceilinged room with curved log walls, a small stove with a crooked chimney pipe, a patchwork quilt folded on a wooden bench, clay pots of growing things on every ledge, a tiny door in the corner that leads somewhere else entirely, a round window in the end wall

MUSHROOM BURROW ROOM: a hobbit-round room with smooth plastered walls, a bent-chimney stove glowing in the corner, a fat armchair on a circular rug, a wall hung with trailing dried herbs, a wonky bookshelf leaning gently, a small round window cut through the thick wall opposite the stove

LIGHTHOUSE KEEPER'S ROOM: a curved tower room with whitewashed walls following the circle of the building, a narrow iron bunk, a fold-down shelf holding a fat teapot and a cauldron-sized mug, a braided rope mat on the floor, a porthole window in the curved outer wall beside the bunk

BEACON TOWER ROOM: a round lighthouse room with stone walls and a curved wooden floor, a small iron bed tucked against the curve, a mushroom lamp on a built-in ledge, a patchwork curtain hung across a low alcove, a wide circular porthole window set into the curving wall at bed height

CLICKETY SLEEPER CABIN: a cosy train bunk room with wood-panelled walls, a narrow bunk bed with a quilt tucked in tight, a fold-down table latched to the wall, a small brass lamp mounted above the table, a long rectangular window set flush in the wall right beside the fold-down table

VELVET SLEEPER CABIN: a snug wood-panelled sleeping car room, an upper bunk draped with a patchwork quilt, a fold-down table below with a fat teapot perched on it, a mushroom lamp bolted to the panelling, a narrow rectangular window beside the lower bunk seat

TREEHOUSE CANOPY ROOM: a treehouse room with a living branch growing through the corner and leafing across the ceiling, pots of ferns hanging at every height, a small bed tucked against the trunk, a patchwork quilt thrown over it, a wide unframed window between two branches on the front wall

GREENHOUSE BEDROOM: a warm glass-roofed room where plants grow through the floorboards and climb the iron frame, a small bed tucked inside a ring of potted ferns, a mushroom lamp on a terracotta pot turned upside down, trailing vines framing a tall arched glass window in the end wall
